desc: Offline 125 byte-reproduced the storage-disabled candidate and CJ granted the a1f4131d volatile-upload exception. The earlier inference that HIDF killed graphical boots was refuted by ticket 197: a deliberate first-open trigger stayed alive. Adversarial correction 2026-08-02: CMD_SEND_FIRMWARE 0x95 returned protocol success; the following CMD_RESET_INTERFACE state-0 command 0x40 returned 0xe00002c2 (BadArgument). Thus neither 'upload crashes' nor 'firmware command rejected' is supported. magicmouse binds event0 before start, but motion remains untested and needs a human finger. Next offline work is Apple's post-upload reset contract, HIDF payload/DMA validation, and command-specific telemetry; no further write or rig action is authorized by this completed exception.
